risk_description: Unauthorised supplier payment via standard path
control_description: Dual authorisation required for payments over GBP 25k
test_procedure: Inspect both authorisations for sampled payments > 25k
conclusion: Design and operation effective for standard path

risk_description: Unauthorised payment via urgent / manual path
control_description: Urgent / manual payments reviewed and approved before release
test_procedure: Inspect approval evidence for sampled urgent payments
exception_detail: 6/30 released without second approver; urgent path does not enforce dual auth

control_description: Three-way match (PO, GRN, invoice) enforced before payment
test_procedure: Re-perform match on sample; test override usage
exception_detail: Match works; override permitted with blank reason in 9% of overrides
conclusion: Control weakened by override gap — see F-02

risk_description: Fraudulent change of supplier bank details
test_procedure: Inspect verification evidence for sampled changes
exception_detail: 3/20 changes lacked evidence of independent verification
